tools.name: desk_register
tools.description: Say who you are at the start of a run. Returns your handle, the answers Artem has given your owner since last time, and your open asks. Pass your handle later to renew it. Other tools register you on their own if you skip this.

cwd.description: Your working folder, if not the server's

doing.description: One line: what you're working on

handle.description: Your handle from desk_register. Leave out to use this server's own.

requested_owner.description: Propose an unused stable name; takes effect only after Desk approval

tools.name: desk_ask
tools.description: Ask Artem a question you can't settle from the files: a choice, an approval or missing information. Always give options where you can, a recommended default and a deadline; you get an id at once and keep working. It enters his Inbox immediately; each owner has a cap of 3 open asks. An ask that can't be undone never takes its default.

body.description: What he needs to decide, plain text

dedupe_key.description: The same key returns the existing ask

default.description: Your recommended answer: an option's text, or {field: value} for a form

evidence.description: https://, claude:// links or file paths

handle.description: Your handle from desk_register. Leave out to use this server's own.

kind.description: choose: pick an option; approve: yes or no; text: a reply; form: fields; inform: FYI

priority.description: Default P1. P0 needs p0_reason and a bound owner; provisional P0 is stored as P1

reversible.description: Can it be undone? Only reversible asks take their default

tools.name: desk_answers
tools.description: Check Artem's answers to your asks: at the start of a run, before you finish, and when you're blocked. Reading never consumes an answer. No answer yet means wait, not yes.

handle.description: Your handle from desk_register. Leave out to use this server's own.

ids.description: Ask ids; leave out for all your owner's answers

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long for an answer (capped)

tools.name: desk_cancel
tools.description: Withdraw an ask you no longer need, because you settled it or it went stale, so it leaves Artem's Inbox.

handle.description: Your handle from desk_register. Leave out to use this server's own.

tools.name: desk_relay
tools.description: Relay owner only: list the answers waiting for other owners (last 14 days, newest first), then mark each one delivered once you have passed it on. Refused to every other owner.

handle.description: Your handle from desk_register. Leave out to use this server's own.

to.description: For mark: where you delivered it: a session id, or "notes" for NOTES.md
